items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-05-11
items.q: I have one of his numbers here that Crawford sent me in one of his arrangements. This happens to be his number here that Crawford wants me to record for him.

ctx.x: Oh yes, down there. Way down in the bottom.

Where Spanish people know that. That's right. Then I played with him on a couple of the trucks down there. And when I had gone back on a visit to New Orleans. And Piku and I were great friends. Because I had a cousin down there, Armand Pierron, which I have one of his numbers here that Crawford sent me in one of his arrangements. This happens to be his number here that Crawford wants me to record for him. I know this is Alvin Piku. This is Piron in Bocage. Or Mama's Gone Goodbye. That's a great... That's a good…
I'm sure with your experience and the natural talent and the way you played, it wouldn't be hard to come back. That's right.
